title: RES↔ML-001: Novel ML Findings + TFLite Micro Feasibility
description: Researcher delivers a novel ML findings package (model architecture, training methodology, experimental results, unconventional operator requirements, preprocessing specifications); Edge AI/ML returns a TFLite Micro feasibility assessment within 15 business days (operator-support verification, estimated tensor-arena size, estimated inference latency, CMSIS-NN compatibility, showstopper gaps). Grounded in IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6.5.

experimental_results.description: Reported metrics (e.g., accuracy, F1) with their definitions.

unconventional_operator_requirements.description: Operators outside the standard TFLite Micro set.

preprocessing_specifications.description: Preprocessing spec (Python golden reference + test vectors expected).

tflite_micro_feasibility.description: ML→RES: TFLite Micro feasibility assessment (within 15 business days).

unsupported_operators.description: Required when operator_support is PARTIAL or UNSUPPORTED.

estimated_inference_latency_ms.description: Estimated on-target inference latency in ms.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Novel ML modalities frequently exceed the contracted/precedented surface — novelty score may exceed 0.80 (ESC-NOV). Transfer aligns with the quarterly Technology Transfer Review; feasibility findings feed model-deployment ADRs.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (Scheduled ML Research Transfer at quarterly TTR; novel ML findings ≥3 weeks before review; TFLite Micro feasibility within 15 business days; initial feasibility scan within 10 business days)
confirm_conditions: ml_findings carries a finding_id and a model_architecture description
estimated tensor_arena_kb and inference_latency_ms reported with units when feasible
reject_conditions: verdict = FEASIBLE while showstopper_gaps remain unresolved
operator_support = PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED with no unsupported_operators listed
experimental results reported without metric definitions (not reproducible)
counter_conditions: novel modality requires high-complexity assessment — request the extended window and flag ESC-NOV (novelty > 0.80)
preprocessing spec lacks a golden reference / test vectors — request them before fixed-point feasibility
FEASIBLE_WITH_CUSTOM_KERNELS — request the kernel-development effort estimate before transfer commit
